what_it_does: Data exploration controls in dataset results and metric view preview: The dataset results table and the metric view preview grid now include column pinning and formatting, search, a column explorer, natural language filtering, and a selection details panel. Include style level of detail (LOD) expressions in the metric view editor: The metric view editor now supports include style LOD expressions. Ignore filters on a widget: You can now configure a dashboard widget to ignore selected dashboard filters, so those filters don't affect the widget while they continue to apply to the rest of the page.
why_it_matters: Reduces operational overhead and unlocks new capabilities for data teams on Databricks.
